time.expression: Scaled-dual log₂ cost ≈ [2L/(2L+1)] · (unscaled-dual log₂ cost), in the stated sparse-FHE regime

space.expression: Depends on the chosen dual-lattice solver.

notes: A relative improvement in the source’s fixed-width sparse-FHE regime q=n^L·2^{O(L)}. It is not a universal exponent for LWE and need not beat exhaustive sparse-secret search when h is constant.

extra.parameters: q(n) with log₂q=L log₂n+O(L), fixed L>0, constant Gaussian width αq=8 and fixed sparse weight h (source example h=64); source scaled dimension m′=2n.
extra.noise: Discrete Gaussian width αq=8, i.e. standard deviation 8/√(2π), independent of n.
extra.secret: Uniform sparse ternary secret of fixed Hamming weight h, as in the source’s HElib asymptotic model.
extra.samples: Enough samples for the selected dual-lattice dimension; actual m must be enforced when instantiating.
extra.objective: Decision-LWE under a scaled dual-lattice attack.
extra.model: Relative exponent scaling 2L/(2L+1) against the corresponding unscaled dual model.
extra.assumptions: Source lattice-reduction and small-secret scaling model; fixed h and L are essential.
extra.success: Use the same target distinguishing advantage in both compared dual cost models.
